title: Graphic Digital Design Co-Op – Summer 2027
note: Marketing graphic design co-op working on brochures, spec sheets and launch materials; Adobe CC required; no visa sponsorship.

facts.summary: Summer co-op on Crown's marketing graphics team.
facts.duties: Brochure and spec sheet updates, product launch and campaign support, translations, holiday card, B2B email best-practice research.
facts.requirements: Enrolled in a 4-year program; Mac and Adobe CC (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop); video, 3D or web a plus; Office skills; own transportation. Crown does not sponsor; temporary-visa holders are not eligible.
